fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Lower runs first where two schemes measure the same thing for the same rep. Both still pay - this only fixes the order they are computed in, so a re-run produces the same rows in the same sequence.

fields.label: Measured On
fields.options:
Value
Volume
Outlet Coverage
Productive Calls
New Outlets
Lines Per Call
fields.description: Which target's achievement decides the slab. One scheme reads one target; a scheme that averaged two would be paying on a number nobody was given.

fields.label: Category
fields.description: Blank pays on the overall target. Set it to pay on a category push - and then the rep needs the category line on their plan, or there is nothing to measure against.

fields.label: Qualifies At
fields.description: Below this, nothing is earned whatever the slabs say. Kept separate from the first slab so a scheme can be read at a glance: this is the line the rep has to cross, and the table below is what happens after.

fields.label: Cap
fields.description: The most one rep can earn in one period. Zero means no cap. A percent-of-value scheme with no cap is how one unusual month becomes a payroll problem.

fields.label: Designation
fields.options:
Field Rep
Senior Field Rep
Area Manager
Regional Manager
fields.description: Blank means everybody. A blank Link filled from a session default is the trap ADR-020 describes, so this is a Select with a real empty option rather than a Link.

fields.label: Territory
fields.description: Blank means everywhere. Set it and the scheme reaches this territory and everything under it.

fields.label: Sales Person
fields.description: Blank means the whole tree. Set it to run a scheme for one branch - the node and everybody below it.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: In the words the rep will hear it in. This is what the phone shows under the slab.
